column3: Web uploads of 8 MiB or less are put once; an upload skips the put when its blob was put within the last hour
column4: the staged path cost two Class A writes, a read and a delete per upload, and an unconditional put rewrote identical content; reuse is capped at an hour so the 24 h orphan sweep grace still covers every upload before its commit (review of xin#3)
column5: plugins/files/files.test.ts: identical content keeps its R2 version, an hour-old blob is put again, a staged body leaves no tmp/ key
